summary: Kiribati waives visas for citizens of the 124 countries and territories listed in its 2023 visa exemption order — including the UK, Ireland, most of the EU, the US, China, Japan, Australia, New Zealand and its Pacific neighbors — who may stay up to 90 days in any 12 months. Everyone else must obtain a visitor visa from Kiribati Immigration before traveling. All visitors need a passport valid six months, an onward ticket and funds for the stay.

passportValidity.text: Kiribati's Entry and Visa Exemption Order 2023 requires visa-exempt visitors to hold a passport valid for at least 6 months on the day they leave Kiribati. The UK government says your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least 2 blank pages.

travelInsurance.text: No official source we could read states a travel-insurance requirement for visitors to Kiribati. The UK Foreign Office says anything beyond basic treatment usually means medical evacuation, and advises adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover evacuation by air ambulance, treatment abroad and repatriation.

source.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — Kiribati travel advice: health

onwardTicket.text: The UK government says you must hold a ticket for return or onward travel and enough funds for your stay. Kiribati's Immigration Procedures say an immigration officer may ask arriving passengers for evidence of onward travel arrangements.

proofOfFunds.text: Kiribati's Immigration Procedures say an immigration officer may ask arriving passengers for evidence of funds for their maintenance or of sponsorship; no amount is stated. The UK government says you must have enough funds for your stay.

declarations.name: Arrival Card, Customs and Quarantine Declaration
declarations.text: Arriving passengers complete an arrival card, which Kiribati's Immigration Procedures treat as their application for entry permission. The UK government says there is a strict quarantine regime for importing food, plant and animal (including fish) products.

notes: The UK government says there is a strict quarantine regime for importing food, plant and animal (including fish) products.
Canada's travel advice says importing firearms, ammunition, explosives, counterfeit money and goods, knives and pornography is strictly prohibited.

safety.text: The UK government says the wet season, normally November to April, can bring strong winds and sea swells, with flooding and coastal inundation disrupting essential services, and advises drinking only boiled or bottled water. Canada reports organized crime, mostly drug-related, in Kiribati waters.

tips.text: The UK government says very few places accept credit cards, and that there are ATMs at Bank of Kiribati and ANZ branches in Betio, Bairiki and Bikenibeu on Tarawa.

The UK government says medical facilities at the general hospital in Tarawa are modest, that medicines are generally not available so you should bring any you need, and that any non-basic treatment usually means medical evacuation, so your insurance should cover evacuation by air ambulance.
Canada's travel advice says severe rainstorms in the November to April rainy season can hamper air and sea travel.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Kiribati?
faq.answer: It depends on your passport. Kiribati's Entry and Visa Exemption Order 2023 waives the visa for citizens of 124 countries and territories, including the UK, Ireland, most EU states, the US, Canada, China, Japan, Australia, New Zealand and Kiribati's Pacific neighbors; they may stay up to 90 days in any 12 months. Everyone else must obtain a visitor visa before traveling. A traveler who arrives with neither a visa nor an exemption is liable to be turned around.

faq.question: How do I get a visitor visa if my country is not exempt?
faq.answer: Kiribati's Immigration Procedures say that a person without a visa waiver may travel to Kiribati only as the holder of a visa, and that applications must be lodged in the prescribed manner with an immigration officer. No official source we could read describes how to apply from abroad.

faq.question: How long can I stay in Kiribati?
faq.answer: Kiribati's 2023 exemption order allows visa-exempt visitors up to 90 days in any 12-month period. The UK government says one month is normally granted on arrival and that you can apply for one-month extensions, up to a maximum of 3 extra months, from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration in Bairiki, Tarawa.

faq.question: Is travel insurance required for Kiribati?
faq.answer: No official source we could read makes travel insurance a condition of entry. The UK Foreign Office advises it all the same: anything beyond basic treatment usually means medical evacuation, so make sure your policy covers evacuation by air ambulance.

faq.question: Can I use cards or ATMs in Kiribati?
faq.answer: Barely. The UK government says very few places accept credit cards, and ATMs are found at Bank of Kiribati and ANZ branches in Betio, Bairiki and Bikenibeu on Tarawa. Canada's travel advice says the currency is the Australian dollar, that there are a limited number of ATMs and that Visa and MasterCard are accepted at most hotels.
